newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal PSI20 stock index surges 4.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Portugal PSI20 stock index surges 4.0 pct.

text.p: Portugal's PSI20 index of leading blue chip shares soared 4.06 percent on Friday to a record 6,611.12 points after a ratings agency promoted the country to developed from emerging market.
Prices were also being given a further boost by the strength of Wall Street, dealers said.
Wall Street was seen as certain to gain after U.S. non-farm payrolls rose less than forecast in April, triggering a rise in bond prices there.

The Portuguese market had surged from the bell on Friday, reacting to the decision by Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) on Wednesday to switch the country to its developed markets indices from December.
Thursday was a holiday in Portugal.

Buying focused on leading blue chip stocks likely to benefit most from the revision in the MSCI rating which is expected to make Portugal more attractive to big international investment funds. --Lisbon bureau 3511-3150035
